name: Video Course Player
summary: Video course player CodeComponent using VideoJS extension library. VideoJS player initialized with useRef + useEffect in a 16:9 AspectRatio container. Chapter sidebar uses Accordion with 3 modules, each containing 3-4 lessons. Each lesson shows Progress bar (watched %) and Badge (Complete/In Progress/Not Started). Click lesson loads video via placeholder URL. Completion AlertDialog shown when lesson finishes. Mark Complete button triggers useHandler('markComplete'). Uses useModel pattern for course content (demo data: 3 modules, 10 lessons), useAppState for current lesson and progress tracking.
shortSummary: VideoJS course player with chapter sidebar, progress tracking, completion dialog, and mark complete handler
